steps: Run unchanged worker-guard parent-exit test, also alone with --test-name-pattern=Parent exit.
expected: Owned writer is stopped before preserved checkpoint is treated as final; final bytes remain stable.
actual: Snapshot baseline plus two ticks differs from bytes 300ms later (five ticks). Reproduced in full and isolated runs.
follow_up: Review process identity after parent reparenting, actual child termination and checkpoint ordering. Preserve the regression; do not weaken the assertion.

steps: Using real private SQLite review implementation, save ACCEPTED then NEEDS_WORK at the same persisted timestamp.
expected: Most recent explicit decision NEEDS_WORK is returned.
actual: listReviews returns ACCEPTED. SQL sorts only by timestamp, with no monotonic tie-breaker.
follow_up: Preserve insertion/decision ordering deterministically and test equal timestamp decisions. No whole-app acceptance may derive from an interface rating.

steps: Run exact compiler regression project on Linux SDK 10.0.401 with isolated artifacts.
expected: Deliberate permission-denied replacement is tested while checking prior bundle/staging preservation.
actual: Two tests expect IOException but Linux returns UnauthorizedAccessException; later preservation assertions are not reached.
follow_up: Define platform-correct failure contract without weakening preservation/staging assertions. Re-run on Windows and Linux.
